role: The empty map: right click creates a filled_map ItemStack with a fresh MapData centred on the player.
scope_reason: world.conf maps = off: 'an empty map stays empty'. ItemEmptyMap.onItemRightClick begins with the WorldConf.maps hook and returns the stack, in the oracle as well.

members.name: onItemRightClick
members.note: the WorldConf.maps hook short-circuits it; MapData is never created in this game

notes: Filled maps from loot are likewise switched off, so ItemMapBase's onUpdate stays dead. lane/itemuse: iu-off-s1 uses it with world.conf's switch off (used on the ground and in the air: nothing happens).
